title: SM Energy Co 8-K Filing — 2026-04-30
summary: SM Energy Company completed its South Texas Divestiture on April 30, 2026, receiving approximately $900 million in net cash proceeds from the sale of approximately 61,000 net acres in Webb County, Texas to Caturus Energy, LLC. The company intends to use proceeds to redeem in full $819 million aggregate principal of its 2026 Senior Notes (6.75% and 5.0%). The borrowing base was reaffirmed at $5.0 billion with $2.5 billion in aggregate lender commitments.
key_points: SM Energy completed the South Texas Divestiture on April 30, 2026, with net cash proceeds of approximately $900 million
Assets sold included approximately 61,000 net acres in the southern Maverick Basin position in Webb County, Texas
Purchaser was Caturus Energy, LLC; purchase agreement dated February 17, 2026
Company will redeem $819 million aggregate principal of 6.75% Senior Notes due 2026 and 5.0% Senior Notes due 2026 at par
Semi-annual borrowing base redetermination reaffirmed at $5.0 billion with $2.5 billion aggregate lender commitments
Final purchase price remains subject to customary post-closing adjustments
